answer: Approximately 5.6% (1 of 18) of the original studies in the Experimental Economics replication project were conducted in the United Kingdom. Hypothesis: In the "Heterogeneity in Replication Projects" dataset, the Experimental Economics (ee) replication project comprises 18 unique original studies, and exactly one of them — ee.13, "Deferred compensation in multiperiod labor contracts: an experimental test of Lazear's model" by Steffen Huck, Andrew J. Seltzer, and Brian Wallace (2011) — was conducted in the United Kingdom (experiment_country.o = "United Kingdom"). Therefore, the proportion of EE original studies conducted in the UK is 1/18 ≈ 0.056 (5.6%). The remainder were conducted in the United States (11/18, 61.1%), Germany (2), Switzerland (2), Australia (1), and Austria (1). Caveat: the dataset records a single country per study, so any original experiment run in multiple countries could be miscounted; with one clean UK label and zero missing values, this does not affect the computed proportion here.

payload.hypothesis: In the Experimental Economics (ee) replication project, 1 of 18 unique original studies (5.6%) was conducted in the United Kingdom — specifically ee.13 (Huck, Seltzer & Wallace, 2011, 'Deferred compensation in multiperiod labor contracts'); the rest were run in the United States (11), Germany (2), Switzerland (2), Australia (1), and Austria (1).

uk_study.authors: Steffen Huck and Andrew J. Seltzer and Brian Wallace
uk_study.title: Deferred compensation in multiperiod labor contracts: an experimental test of Lazear's model

payload.workflow: Loaded meta-regression_study_data_heterogeneity_in_replication_projects.csv; filtered to project=='ee' (18 rows); verified one row per original study via unique id/title and empty lab_id/aggregated (defensive dedup by id not triggered); denominator = 18 studies with non-missing, non-ambiguous experiment_country.o (0 missing excluded); numerator = 1 study with experiment_country.o=='United Kingdom'; proportion = 1/18 = 0.0556 (5.6%). Second dataset contains no country columns and was not used.
